evidence.section: 4.1 Effects of heat treatment on eutectic regions and the underlying mechanism
evidence.quote: The OM image shows that a large number of fine equiaxed grains, with sizes mostly in the range of 1-3 μm, appear in the as-built sample

evidence.section: 4.1 Effects of heat treatment on eutectic regions and the underlying mechanism
evidence.quote: the representative OM image of the heat-treated samples shows coarse NiTi equiaxed grains with sizes ranging from 3 to 10 μm
HAADF-STEM images show that after 20% strain, the matrix was mostly composed of B19’ twinned martensite, and different types of twins were staggered.

Compared to mesh-like β-Nb, independent β-Nb enabled the adjacent matrix to have a more favorable twinning orientation, which could effectively release strain energy through stress- induced martensitic transformation.

As an SMA, the NiTi matrix during stressing is more prone to undergo SIM and twinning rather than accumulating dislocations, contributing to ductility improvement and reflecting both TRIP and TWIP effects
Furthermore, heat treatment (aging) will introduce hard intermetallic precipitates, which can impede dislocation movement and lead to precipitation strengthening

evidence.section: 4.2 Strength-ductility enhancement mechanism of heat treatment
evidence.quote: All of these can effectively pile up dislocations and achieve synergistic twin boundary-associated strengthening effects, providing continuous strain hardening capability

It was observed that a complete micro-crack initiated from Ti 2 Ni, passed through the matrix almost without deflection, terminated in β-Nb, and caused dislocation entanglement, indicating that β-Nb could effectively buffer cracks

As an SMA, the NiTi matrix during stressing is more prone to undergo SIM and twinning rather than accumulating dislocations, contributing to ductility improvement and reflecting both TRIP and TWIP effects

evidence.section: 4.2 Strength-ductility enhancement mechanism of heat treatment
evidence.quote: While the ductility was enhanced by modulating the eutectic microregion, the twin-boundary assisted strengthening by staggered twins and the precipitation strengthening of Ti 2 Ni together provided excellent strain hardening capability. Ultimately, a synergistic strength-ductility enhancement of NiTi-Nb alloy was achieved.

evidence.section: 4.2 Strength-ductility enhancement mechanism of heat treatment
evidence.quote: Therefore, the destruction of mesh-like β-Nb into independent β-Nb by heat treatment can enable the adjacent matrix to have a more favorable twinning orientation, release more strain energy, and effectively enhance ductility.
